entries.en: Ehh – I'm not looking for trouble.
Fuck, uh... Do I know you?
I didn't mean to, so sorry.
Ey, I don't understand…. I was at his beck and call, I didn't take a single day off...
entries.ro: Ey, nu înțeleg... Eram la dispoziția lui, n-am luat nicio zi liberă...

entries.en: Don't yell, please… I know… I didn't do it on purpose.
entries.ro: Nu mai țipa, te rog... Știu... N-am vrut, jur.

entries.en: Eh, man come on. I've already been mugged today. Just leave me alone.
entries.ro: Eh, frate, hai. Am fost jefuit deja azi. Lasă-mă în pace.

entries.en: But… but… Please don't do this to me… please.
entries.ro: Dar... dar... Te rog, nu-mi face asta... te rog.
